title: Compare US business locations with local industry context
reason: User branches carry confirmed US geography and NAICS edition/code; sales specify month and USD,employees may carry SOC and pay period. Proposed vintage-matched geography→CBP industry/year,selected CPI→month and matching OEWS occupation/area/year provide local context. Ask business density,real versus nominal growth and comparable pay bands. Visuals: county map and uncertainty chart. Pubs state/ZIP requires proven US context; ZIP is not ZCTA. Demo job titles/product categories are not SOC/NAICS. No Employees currency/geography inferred. Census credentials/rights,classification mapping,suppression and historic wage availability remain gaps.
practical_value: Proposed connected bundle; identity, temporal, legal and match-rate review required. Not selected or implemented.
showcase_value: Named visualisations support the questions; practical joinability dominates.
